chapter: Wagon bands, halls and the old brass bands
title: Evan Thomas and the Black Eagle Band, murdered with a cane knife
summary: Evan Thomas was chopped down mid-performance by a man just out of prison whose woman he had been seeing.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Evan Thomas was killed out there. He was going with a cat's old lady who was in the penitentiary.

Evan Thomas. The Black Eagle Band. It was a helluva band. They used to come to New Orleans occasionally. And Evan Thomas was going out with some cat's old lady. Cats went to the penitentiary and told... It was a freaky thing, like a country club down there, the penitentiary shit, you know...

He went up there and told this cat, whoever he was, that Evan Thomas was going with his old lady. And the cat said, 'When I come out of here, I'm gonna kill him.' Sure enough, he got out, and he got a cane knife, one of them machetes, and walked in the hall, and just walked... Evan Thomas was up there blowing his horn, and he just went up there and chopped him down. There was blood all over the place. Killed him right in front of the people.
